verdict.rationale: Neon's CLI is well documented (create/init/claim, connection string/.env writing, `inspect db` with 15 read-only health checks, `ask`, `api-keys`) and runtime probes confirm it works keylessly, but the evidence never shows a dedicated 'shell into' command (e.g. a built-in psql wrapper) — the GitHub docs instead point users to external clients like psql/dbeaver for that step. missing for 10: explicit CLI subcommand for opening an interactive DB shell, independent hands-on confirmation of the full create→connect→shell→inspect loop end-to-end.
